results.instruction: Stop the car safely on a firm level surface away from traffic.
Set up a warning triangle and turn on the hazard lights.
Apply the parking brake and put the gear in Park.
Switch off the ignition and ensure all passengers exit the vehicle.
Retrieve the spare wheel and tools from the trunk.
Use the tool provided to remove the hubcap if the wheel has one.
Use the wrench to loosen the wheel nuts one half to one turn.
If nuts are tight, use your foot to help loosen them.
Find the jacking point closest to the wheel on the vehicle's underside.
Never put any object or body part under the vehicle when using the jack.
Jack up the vehicle until the flat tire clears the ground.
Do not touch the disc wheels or brakes as they can be hot.
Remove the wheel nuts and take off the flat tire.
Lift the spare wheel onto the hub and line up the holes.
Replace the wheel nuts and tighten them until they are firm.
Lower the jack until the spare wheel touches the ground.
Use the wrench to tighten the wheel nuts firmly in sequence.
Lower the car completely, remove the jack, and store the tools.
Do not exceed 80 kilometers per hour when driving with a compact spare wheel.
